scenes.prompt: A French father in a living room holds up a wall clock with a comic pleading face, while one child aged 8 plays with a game controller in front of a television, another stares at a tablet and a third watches a phone, board games stacked and untouched, a cat yawning.

Three children aged 7 to 10 dressed as little knights with cardboard armor, golden paper crowns and a helmet with a red plume burst out of a front door into a sunny cobbled Alsatian lane with half-timbered houses and geraniums, one waving an old treasure map, a smiling parent following with a phone.

Children aged 7 to 10 dressed as knights with crowns and a red plumed helmet search for hidden clues in a flowery Alsatian village square: one looks behind a stone fountain with a magnifying glass, one peeks under a wooden bench, one finds a rolled parchment in a flower pot, half-timbered houses around. Plain surfaces, no carvings, no inscriptions.

Children aged 7 to 10 dressed as knights with crowns and a red plumed helmet whisper a secret word to each other and open a small wooden treasure chest glowing with golden light under a big old tree, half-timbered Alsatian houses in the background, delighted faces.
